tickets.body: Following up again on the timeout issue we first flagged in November — it's still happening and we've had to fall back to smaller templates for two reporting cycles now. Please can this get proper attention, not just a workaround.

tickets.subject: API calls failing intermittently since this morning
tickets.body: Our nightly sync job started throwing 500s from the Kataja API overnight. We need this working before the first close of the year — can someone check the API status?

tickets.subject: Alerts not triggering — third week running
tickets.body: Nobody was notified when revenue crossed the threshold again this week. We've now missed two internal deadlines because of this. This needs fixing properly, not just re-saved.

tickets.subject: API down again — third time this month
tickets.body: The API integration has failed for the third time since New Year's. Thirty days to fix something like this is not acceptable for a Professional plan. Our finance team is manually re-pulling numbers because we can't trust the automated feed.

tickets.subject: API broken AGAIN
tickets.body: Same error as January. Nothing has actually changed. We need someone senior looking at this, not another ticket that sits open for a month.

tickets.subject: Requesting a call — pattern of unresolved issues since last year
tickets.body: I'd like to escalate this. Since November we've had recurring problems across report builder, alerts and the API, several sitting open for weeks at a time. The report builder is now failing on our quarterly close templates, which is the third module to break this year. Can we get someone from your side on a call this week to talk through what's actually going on, rather than another isolated fix?

tickets.subject: Seat count wrong again ahead of renewal
tickets.body: Our admin panel is showing three more seats than we actually have provisioned, which is affecting our renewal quote. Given everything else this year, I'd like this checked properly rather than just adjusted on the invoice.

tickets.subject: API failures — still no root cause after all this
tickets.body: The API has failed again, same symptoms as January and February. At this point I don't think a patch is going to hold. We need to understand what is actually wrong before we can commit to renewing at this level.

tickets.subject: API fix — confirming it's holding
tickets.body: Wanted to note that the API has been stable since your team's change last week, and this time the fix came back to us in three days rather than weeks. Appreciate the follow-through on this one.

tickets.subject: Export missing a column
tickets.body: Small one — the CSV export from the finance dashboard is dropping the cost centre column. Not urgent but would be good to get sorted this week.

tickets.subject: Quick API question on rate limits
tickets.body: Now that the sync is stable again, can you confirm what our current API rate limit is? Want to plan a new integration without tripping anything.

tickets.subject: Thanks for the quick seat adjustment
tickets.body: Seats are corrected and the renewal quote now matches what we actually use. Two days turnaround, much appreciated — quite a change from earlier in the year.

tickets.subject: API access for new analyst
tickets.body: Could you provision API access for a new analyst joining our team? Happy to send the usual details. Things have been running smoothly on our end lately, good to see.

tickets.subject: Feature idea — save report builder tab order
tickets.body: Small suggestion: it would help if Report builder remembered the order we arrange tabs in, rather than resetting each session. Not a blocker, just a nice-to-have if it's easy on your end.

tickets.subject: Custom report template help
tickets.body: We're trying to build a board-ready report template in Report builder and could use a pointer on nesting sections. Thanks in advance — the platform has been great to work with so far.

tickets.subject: Feature request: bulk seat management
tickets.body: As we've grown the team it's become a bit tedious adding users one at a time in Admin & seats. Would it be possible to add a bulk import option, e.g. via CSV? Would save us a fair bit of admin time.

tickets.subject: New connector setup for our warehouse
tickets.body: Could you help us set up a new data connector to our Snowflake instance? We'd like to have it running before the next planning cycle.

tickets.subject: Conditional formatting in report builder
tickets.body: Is it possible to apply conditional formatting (colour scale or threshold-based) to a table built in the report builder, similar to what you'd do in a spreadsheet? I've looked through the available widget settings but can't find an option for it. If it's not currently supported, is it on the roadmap? Would be useful for a couple of our recurring finance reports. Juha

tickets.subject: Exported PDF layout differs from on-screen report
tickets.body: When exporting our monthly report to PDF, the column widths and page breaks come out differently than what's shown on screen, cutting off the last column on wider tables. For now we're exporting to Excel instead and adjusting the layout manually before sending it externally, which works but adds a step every month that shouldn't really be necessary. Could the PDF export logic be looked at? Juha

tickets.subject: Dashboard export mismatch — still routing through Excel
tickets.body: Following up briefly on the export formatting issue from March — we've settled into a routine now where the on-screen dashboard gets exported to Excel and reformatted there before it goes into the monthly pack, so it's not causing us any real trouble day to day. Just didn't want it to look like the issue disappeared on its own. No need to prioritise on our end. Juha
